Card Q&A.q: I played a Digimon with 5000 DP or less in a state where my opponent used this card's [When Digivolving][On Deletion] effect to give all of my Digimon -5000 DP. Can I activate my played Digimon's [On Play] effect before it's deleted by its DP becoming 0?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must activate it whenever possible.
